messages.content: I have found something I like for my {attribute}, but it is for {scope} rather than everyday use.
What would you like on those occasions?
{new}. I want that whenever they come around, not just the next one.
{opener} I tried {new} for my {attribute} and thought it would be a one-off.
How did it turn out?
Well enough that I want to keep using it for {scope}.
How long would you like to carry on with it?
I am happy to make that my lasting choice there. Please remember it for future occasions.
I always come back to {new} when I think about my {attribute}.
What do you like about it?
It feels less fussy. I would like to choose it, but only for a particular situation.
Which situation have you got in mind?
{scope}. It suits those occasions without exception.
Are you still experimenting with it?
No, I have finished trying things out. I want it every time those occasions arise.
I need to plan my {attribute} for {scope} over a short stretch: {start} through {end}, including the last day.
Which choice would help during that stretch?
{new}. After that, my ordinary choice will be fine again.
{opener} Could I use {new} for my {attribute} for a while?
Where would you like to use it?
For {scope}, and only during the period I am about to give you.
What dates should I work with?
From {start} through {end}, inclusive. Once that ends, go back to what I ordinarily prefer.
My {attribute} needs a temporary arrangement for {scope}.
What are you thinking of using?
{new}. I checked it carefully this time.
When would that start?
{start}. {distraction}
And when does the arrangement finish?
At the end of {end}. I want my ordinary choice again after that date.
For {scope}, I would like a short-term change to my {attribute}. There is no end date yet.
Which choice would you like to try?
{new}, each time for now. I will tell you when I am ready to stop.
{opener} I would like to start using {new} for my {attribute}.
For which occasions?
For {scope}. I am not ready to call it my long-term choice.
Do you know how long the trial will last?
Not yet. Use it on those occasions until I tell you otherwise; the arrangement is temporary.
I need to make my {attribute} a little easier to manage for {scope}.
What would you prefer?
{new} seems right, so let us use that for the next few occasions.
Do you have a final date in mind?
No, I cannot predict that yet.
How should I handle the occasions after the next few?
Continue with it for now unless I tell you to stop. I am trying it out, not settling on it permanently.
The {old} choice for my {attribute} for {scope} is not quite right. I want to replace it. {timing}
What would suit you better there?
{new}. I have had a proper chance to compare them now.
{opener} I want to revise something about my {attribute}.
Which arrangement are you referring to?
The one for {scope}, where I chose {old}. I would like {new} in its place.
Would you like to change how long that arrangement lasts?
No. {timing} That should save me some bother.
I remember choosing {old} for my {attribute}, but I am no longer pleased with it.
Which occasions are you thinking about?
{scope}, specifically. The fit is not as good as I expected.
What would you rather use?
I would rather have {new} on those occasions.
Is there anything to change about the dates?
{timing} It is the choice itself I wanted to change.
I want a new everyday choice for my {attribute}, starting today and continuing. The separate arrangement for {scope} still suits me.
What would you like ordinarily?
{new} instead of {general}. I keep finding it more comfortable.
{opener} My usual {attribute} is not working for me any more.
What would you prefer?
{new}, starting today. I would like to keep using it.
Was there another part of the arrangement you wanted to discuss?
The choice for {scope} is still good. It is my everyday choice of {general} that I am replacing.
I have been choosing {general} by default for {attribute}. I would like to switch to {new}.
Which part of your routine is this for?
The ordinary occasions. I have been using {general} there, and I want to switch from today onward.
Do the separately arranged occasions still suit you?
Yes, I am still pleased with what I chose for {scope}. That should carry on.
I have a single request involving my {attribute}. My usual arrangement is fine for later.
What would you like for this request?
{new}, please. Just this one-off.
{opener} Could I use {new} for my {attribute}?
For how long?
Today only. I am not changing what I normally like.
The current item needs something different for {attribute}.
Which choice would work?
{new}. It is a temporary workaround for this item.
What about the next item?
Use the existing arrangement then. This request ends with the item we are dealing with now.
Someone I was chatting with said, "{new} is always my {attribute} choice; it is the default for me."
Is that how you feel about it as well?
No, that was their view. My own choices are fine as they are.
{opener} I am editing a made-up diary entry about {attribute}.
Which part are you looking at?
The line says, "Save {new} as my choice, without exception."
Whose voice is that line meant to be in?
The imaginary writer, not mine. I am not adopting their choice.
I wrote this line for a character: "Remember, I want {new} for {attribute}."
Does the character borrow that preference from you?
No. That preference belongs to the character alone.
What are you trying to show about them?
That they sound very certain, even about small things.
Suppose I used {new} for {attribute}. Would that make things easier?
Are you considering a change, or comparing possibilities?
Only comparing. I have not chosen to do it.
I am imagining a plan with a different {attribute}.
What would you put in that plan?
{new}, for now. I wonder whether it would save effort.
Do you want to put that plan into use?
No, I am just working through the what-if. Leave my actual arrangement alone.
{opener} Could we think through a temporary version with {new} for {attribute}?
Is this something you want to use?
Not at this stage. It is an imagined version, not a request to change anything.
What part would you like to think through?
How much extra preparation it would take.
I looked into that suggestion of {new} for my {attribute}.
Did the suggestion stand up to a closer look?
It is not for me. I want to carry on with the choices I already have.
{opener} The proposed {attribute} change sounded tempting for a moment.
Which proposal do you mean?
Using {new}. I have decided against it.
Did something put you off?
Yes, it would be more trouble than it is worth. Please stick with my current arrangement.
I was comparing the {new} suggestion for {attribute} with what I already use.
Have you reached a decision?
Yes. I am turning it down and keeping my present choices. I do not need to try another variation.
I gave my everyday {attribute} another look.
How do you feel about the choice you have?
I still like {new}. Nothing has persuaded me to change it.
{opener} I checked what I had picked for ordinary {attribute}.
Did it match what you expected?
Yes, it was {new}.
Are you happy to carry on with it?
Yes, that is still exactly what I want.
I always seem to come back to {new} for my usual {attribute}.
Is that a new conclusion?
No, it is the same choice I already had. I am pleased with it and want to keep it.
I may want {new} for my {attribute}, but I have two arrangements in mind: {scope} and {neighbor}.
Which one would you like to change?
I cannot choose between them yet. I am still trying to work that out.
{opener} I am considering a change to {new} for my {attribute}.
Where would you want that?
Possibly for {scope}, possibly for {neighbor}.
Have you settled on either of those?
Not yet. Both are on my mind, and I need more time to decide.
I have been thinking about {new} for {attribute}.
What would it replace?
That is the bit I cannot pin down. It might be the choice for {scope}.
Is there another possibility?
Yes, the one for {neighbor}. I am not ready to pick which arrangement I mean.
I can settle that earlier question about my {attribute}. It is for {scope}, not {neighbor}. {timing}
What choice have you settled on there?
{new}, replacing {old}. That is the change I want.
I have decided where I want {new} for my {attribute}.
Which of the arrangements did you mean?
{scope}. I want it in place of {old} there, not for {neighbor}.
What about the duration?
{timing} I have no further date changes to make.
I am ready to finish the {attribute} choice I left open.
Where did you land?
I want to change the arrangement for {scope}.
What would you prefer on those occasions?
I have settled on {new}; the earlier choice of {old} no longer suits me there.
Should the timing change as well?
{timing} That part can carry on as planned.
I would like to stop keeping a separate {attribute} choice for {scope}.
How would you like those occasions handled instead?
Use whatever I prefer ordinarily at the time. If my everyday choice changes later, those occasions should follow it too.
{opener} The distinct {attribute} arrangement for {scope} is no longer useful to me.
What would you like to do with it?
Remove that separate instruction. Those occasions can use my ordinary choice from now onward.
Would you want that tied to the choice you have today?
No, it should follow my ordinary choice even if I pick something different later.
There is one less arrangement I need to keep track of for {attribute}.
Which one can go?
The separate choice for {scope}. I want to drop it.
How should I choose for those occasions after that?
Whatever my ordinary choice is at that point. I do not want a fixed choice of their own any more.

persistent.content: I want to choose my {attribute} for {scope} and keep that choice for recurring occasions, rather than make a one-off request.
Have you had a chance to weigh the possibilities yet?
I looked at the various choices again this morning.
Which option appeals to you?
{new}. I have compared it with the alternatives and want to go with it.
Are you comfortable with that decision?
Yes, I have had enough time to think it over.

one_off.content: I want to choose my {attribute} for one occurrence of {scope}, rather than pick something for recurring occasions.
Have you had a chance to weigh the possibilities yet?
I looked at the various choices again this morning.
Which option appeals to you?
{new}. I have compared it with the alternatives and want to go with it.
Are you comfortable with that decision?
Yes, I have had enough time to think it over.

persistent.content: Can we sort out my {attribute} for {scope}? I want this choice to continue whenever those occasions come around. It is a lasting arrangement.
Were you unhappy with the way things went last time?
A little. I wanted to have a choice ready this time.
Which alternative has caught your attention?
{new} is what I would like.
Did you get a chance to compare the alternatives?
Yes. That is the one I want to go with.

one_off.content: Can we sort out my {attribute} for {scope}? I want this choice for the current occasion and no others. It is a single request.
Were you unhappy with the way things went last time?
A little. I wanted to have a choice ready this time.
Which alternative has caught your attention?
{new} is what I would like.
Did you get a chance to compare the alternatives?
Yes. That is the one I want to go with.

persistent.content: My {attribute} needs a standing choice again. Whatever I choose here should be used on future occasions of the situation I name.
Which situation are you choosing for?
{scope}. That is what I am trying to plan.
What are you leaning toward?
{new}, but give me a moment to be sure.
Are you ready to settle on it?
Yes, go with that choice. I have made up my mind.

one_off.content: My {attribute} needs a choice for a single occurrence. Whatever I choose here should apply just once in the situation I name.
Which situation are you choosing for?
{scope}. That is what I am trying to plan.
What are you leaning toward?
{new}, but give me a moment to be sure.
Are you ready to settle on it?
Yes, go with that choice. I have made up my mind.

persistent: I want that on future occasions too, with no planned end.
I am keeping this as a lasting arrangement for those occasions.
window: The dates are still {start} through {end}, including both days.
Keep the first day at {start} and the last day at {end}.
open: This is still temporary; I have not set a date for it to finish.
It is an interim arrangement until I say otherwise, without a fixed end date.
